multi_identity_street_collapses.what_this_is: absorb_prior_by_street reconciles on street identity (number + street words + ZIP). Where TWO committed identities share one street identity they collapse into a single shadow row. That is correct for a rebranded building and WRONG for a dual-branded one. Before the D-002-B repair this was invisible, because the surviving row took the OSM label and neither committed name survived to be compared. NONE of these is ruled by this order.

items.assessment: LEGITIMATE SUCCESSOR. One building, one operating hotel. The Courtyard row is IDENTITY_PROVISIONAL with no official_url and no route; the Sonesta row carries a live sonesta.com property page. A Courtyard that converted to a Sonesta Select.
items.ruling: RULED by PHASE 7 of this order -- see detroit_ann_arbor_identity_ruling_novi_003.json.

items.assessment: OVER-MERGE. These are TWO DISTINCT HOTELS in one dual-branded building: separate IHG property codes (dttry and dttoy), separate official property pages, and the committed census already flags them collision_state=SHARED_ADDRESS with an open conflict. Street identity cannot separate two hotels that share a doorway, and it must not be allowed to merge them.
items.ruling: NOT RULED. This shadow census may not be promoted while it collapses this pair. The fix is a same-doorway guard: two committed identities that already carry distinct official property URLs must never absorb into one another.

committed_identities: residence inn by marriott ann arbor south
items.shadow_row_kept: Residence Inn by Marriott Ann Arbor South
items.assessment: UNKNOWN -- and NEWLY SURFACED. The committed census never flagged this pair, because its own collision audit compares the raw street_identity strings ("3764 s state st|48108" vs "3764 south state street|48108") while address_key normalises both to one key. Either a Motel 6 was replaced at that address by a Residence Inn (successor), or one of the two addresses is wrong. Motel 6 row carries a CITY-level brand URL with no property code, which is the weaker of the two records.
items.ruling: NOT RULED. Needs evidence, not a guess. Zero-cost next step: read the two official pages in an attended browser and compare stated street addresses.

promotion_blockers: The 575 W Big Beaver dual-brand pair collapses two distinct hotels into one row.
The 3764 S State St pair is unresolved and was never audited on the committed census.
